events.name: Bash
events.head: Check ancestry, scripts, and publish hold lines
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git fetch -q origin 2>&1|tail -2; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 origin/main && echo ANCESTOR || echo NOT; git rev-list --count origin/main..main; ls app/scripts | grep -iE 'probe-guides|check-guides|anonym|export'; grep -n "publish held\|hold lifted\|HELD" workshop-plan/coord/LOG.md | tail -8; ls -la /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect coord log for hold and last publish
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; L=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md; grep -n -i "publish held\|hold lifted\|held lifted\|lift" $L | tail -8 | cut -c1-300; echo ---; grep -n "PUBLISHED" $L | tail -3 | cut -c1-250; echo; git log --oneline -1 origin/main; git log origin/main --format='%h %ci %s' | grep -n 512c734

events.name: Bash
events.head: Look for hold lifted after line 810
events.input: $ L=/Users/adithyamurali/tantra-round5-coord/LOG.md; grep -n -i "held\b\|hold" $L | awk -F: '$1>810' | tail -8 | cut -c1-260; echo; sed -n 901p $L | cut -c1-600; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git merge-base --is-ancestor 512c734 e66dda5 2>/dev/null && echo "512c734 in T-256 publish"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check probe usage and running servers
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/app; head -30 scripts/probe-guides.mjs | grep -iE "usage|argv|BASE|port|slug" ; head -20 scripts/check-guides.mjs | grep -iE "usage|argv"; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P | grep -E ':(4322|3000|3001)' | awk '{print $1,$9}'
